verdict.rationale: Chargebee documents official MCP Servers that connect AI clients (Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, etc.) to securely access selected Chargebee capabilities, plus a custom MCP server builder for tailored tool subsets. This is first-party documentation confirming the exact capability, but there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of real-world usage. Missing for 10: independent verification/community usage reports of the MCP server working in practice.
